module Schema.Todo.VCurrent exposing [Todo, ValidTitle, tryTitle, newTodo, Project, newProject]

import Tesl.Prelude exposing [Bool(..), Int, String]
import Tesl.String exposing [String.length, String.trim]
import Tesl.Maybe exposing [Maybe(..)]
import Tesl.Time exposing [PosixMillis]

fact ValidTitle (title: String)

# The proof and its pure establishment belong to the versioned schema.
establish tryTitle(raw: String) -> Maybe (title: String ::: ValidTitle title) =
  let title = String.trim raw
  if String.length title > 0 && String.length title <= 120 then
    Something (title ::: ValidTitle title)
  else
    Nothing

entity Todo table "todos" primaryKey id {
  id: String
  title: String ::: ValidTitle title
  completed: Bool
  index [completed]
  details: Maybe String
  dueAt: Maybe PosixMillis
  projectId: Maybe String
  priority: Int
  reminderAt: Maybe PosixMillis
}

# Storage-only additions change this constructor, leaving request handlers alone.
fn newTodo(id: String, title: String ::: ValidTitle title) -> Todo =
  Todo { id: id, title: title, completed: False, details: Nothing, dueAt: Nothing, projectId: Nothing, priority: 0, reminderAt: Nothing }

entity Project table "projects" primaryKey id {
  id: String
  name: String
  archived: Bool
  index [archived]
  description: Maybe String
}

fn newProject(id: String, name: String) -> Project =
  Project { id: id, name: name, archived: False, description: Nothing }
